story_text:
## Meet Heart2Heart
The safety keychain that feels like a hand to hold.
Heart2Heart is a preventive heart shaped safety keychain that makes it easier to reach out to the people you trust whenever you feel unsafe — whether you simply want to feel less alone on your walk home, need reassurance in an uncomfortable situation, or need more immediate help.
## How does it work?
Heart2Heart gives you two simple ways to reach the people you trust — without taking out your phone.
## Level 1: Follow me home
Double press to share your live location with your trusted contacts. They can follow your journey and send heartbeat-like vibrations back to your Heart2Heart, so you can feel that someone is there with you.
## Level 2: Ask for help
Press & hold for 3 seconds when you need your trusted contacts to take action!
They receive an immediate alert that you need help, along with your live location, so they can call you, come to your location or take the action you've agreed on
## Your location. Your choice.
With Heart2Heart, you're always in control of when you share your location and who you share it with. Your trusted contacts can only see your live location when you choose to share it — they can't track you on their own.
Once you stop sharing, they can no longer follow your live location.
Your data is stored on EU-based servers and handled in accordance with GDPR.
## Why vibrations?
Because sometimes, knowing someone is there for you isn't quite the same as feeling it.
When you reach out through Heart2Heart, your trusted contacts can send heartbeat-like vibrations back to your keychain. A small, physical reminder that someone has seen you, is thinking of you and is there with you, even from a distance.
It's our way of making care and connection something you can actually feel.
## Colors
Four colors. One little heart. Which one's yours?
You don't need to choose your color now! You'll be able to pick your favorite Heart2Heart color after the Kickstarter campaign ends.
## Trusted contacts
Your trusted contacts don't need their own Heart2Heart — or even the app — to be there for you, they just need their phone.
When you activate Heart2Heart, they receive an SMS with a link directly on their phone. From here they can follow your journey, send heartbeat-like vibrations back to your keychain and, if you've asked for help, take the action you've agreed on together.
## Subscription & Features
The Heart2Heart keychain works together with our app to keep you connected to the people you trust. An active subscription is required to use its connected safety features.
A subscription is included in all of our rewards! The number of months depends on the reward you choose. After your included subscription period ends, you'll need to actively renew your subscription through the Heart2Heart app.
Your subscription includes 40 SMS messages every month, giving you plenty of moments to reach out to your trusted contacts whenever you need to feel safer. You can easily add more messages through the app whenever you like, with a clear overview of your remaining messages at all times.
## Heart2Heart tech
Small in size, thoughtfully designed for everyday use.
## Battery Life
Heart2Heart is designed to be switched on when you need it and off when you don't. With this kind of everyday use, a single charge can last for weeks.
If kept on continuously, the battery lasts up to 4 days, or approximately 20–30 hours with continuous vibration.
You can always check your Heart2Heart's battery level directly in the app, so you know when it's time to recharge.
## Heart2Heart in action
What started as a university project with a vision to make technology feel softer and more human has grown far beyond the classroom.
Today, Heart2Heart is something you can actually hold in your hands.
We've developed and tested working prototypes with real beta users, turning our vision into a functioning keychain and app. With a double press, users can share their live location with trusted contacts and feel heartbeat-like vibrations sent back to their keychain.
But don't just take our word for it. Here's Heart2Heart in action!
Both the Heart2Heart keychain and app are working today. We're now making the final refinements across both hardware and software!
## BETA-Testers
A few months ago Heart2Heart left our hands!This spring, we produced our first 50 beta Heart2Hearts.
Real people started carrying them, using the app and activating the keychain in their everyday lives. Their feedback showed us what worked, what didn't and what needed to become better.
Here's what our beta testers said:
## Founders story
We're Sofie, Sofie and Nina — three friends who met back in 2020 while studying Digital Design at Aarhus University.
Long before Heart2Heart existed, the three of us were randomly placed in the same study group.
We quickly discovered that we shared more than a degree. We had the same curiosity, the same drive to create things that could make a real difference in people's everyday lives — and, most importantly, we loved working together.
So we kept doing exactly that.
First as study partners. Then as friends. And eventually, as co-founders.
So how did we end up here? A personal problem became a university project. A university project became our thesis. Our thesis became a company. Sketches became prototypes. Prototypes became working hardware and software. And now Heart2Heart is (almost) ready to leave our hands and make a difference in other people's lives.
But let us take you through it all (or at least the highlights).
## 01. Our why
Heart2Heart started with a feeling we all knew too well...
Walking home while constantly checking who's behind you. Sharing your location with a friend. Calling someone just to have a voice on the other end. Taking a different route because it feels safer. And the list of precautions goes on..
For many women, this means constantly adapting the way we move through the world.
When we started talking to our friends and other women, we realized just how many of us had developed these little, invisible precautions without ever really questioning them.
Quickly something else became clear: when we feel unsafe, what we often need most is to know that someone we trust is there for us.
A partner following our location. A parent staying on the phone. A friend saying, “text me when you get home.”
These little acts of care already play such an important role in how we look out for one another. So we started asking ourselves: What if reaching out for support in unsafe situations could be just as easy and natural as all the precautions we've learned to take on our own?
What if feeling safer wasn't only about what we do to protect ourselves, but also about how we show up for each other?
## 02-Research
We fell in love with the problem because we refused to accept that future generations should have to grow up making the same compromises to their freedom that we had learned to live with.
We took any possible opportunity to explore women's experiences of feeling unsafe. The result was a qualitative data bank with lived experiences from more than 500 women across Europe.
The more we explored the problem, the clearer it became that feeling unsafe had become something many women were simply expected to navigate.
Instead of asking how women could get better at adapting to feeling unsafe, we started asking a different question: could we design something that actually responded to the way people experience and navigate these moments in everyday life?
That became the idea behind Heart2Heart.
## 03-Prototyping
Then all of our knowledge was turned into an idea, and then the idea was turned into something physical.
We experimented with shape, interaction and haptic feedback to create something that didn't feel like a traditional safety alarm. As designers, we didn't want to hide the technology behind something neutral or purely functional. We wanted to create something that could feel personal, expressive and worth carrying every day.
This is us showcasing our first Heart2Heart prototype back in 2022. We were so proud and we had no idea back then that bringing Heart2Heart to life would become our full time job a few years later...
## 04-Developing
For Heart2Heart to work the way we imagined, the physical product was only half the story.We developed the keychain and app side by side, creating a system where a simple press on Heart2Heart could reach someone you trust — and their response could travel all the way back as a vibration you can physically feel.
Looking back, there's something a little special about the fact that none of us chose that first study group — yet we've chosen to keep building together ever since.
What started with a randomly assigned study group somehow turned into three best friends building the company of our dreams — around a shared hope that the future can feel safer than the world we grew up in.
Backing Heart2Heart means joining us for this next part of the journey — and we can't wait for our hearts to make their way from our hands to yours!
We believe safety technology can be soft, physical and reassuring. Something you actually want to carry — and something that makes care and connection tangible.
Heart2Heart is our first step towards a softer technological future built around care, connection and solidarity.
## Our community
Heart2Heart has grown from an idea shared by the three of us into more than just a product — it's becoming a growing community.
Through beta testing, events, conversations and our growing online community, we've met so many people who know this feeling from their own lives, who have shared their experiences with us and who want to be part of changing how we think and talk about safety.That community has become an important part of Heart2Heart — shaping what we build and reminding us that this is a conversation much bigger than the three of us.
Please note:
Whether you choose to back Heart2Heart or not, we'd love for you to be part of our community and our aim to create a future that is softer, more inclusive and maybe a bit more pink?
You can join our community by following us on Instagram: @Heart2Heart_dk
## Current status
We've already built and tested Heart2Heart in small batches.
But producing 50 beta devices is very different from producing hundreds — and eventually thousands — of reliable products.
Luckily, we're not doing it alone. We've built a network of engineers, developers, manufacturers, advisors and specialists helping us turn our shared idea into a product that can reach far beyond the three of us.
## Why Kickstarter?
We've proven that Heart2Heart can work. Now it is all about taking the next step! We are ready to move on from small beta batches so we can see Heart2Heart on thousands of bags and in the hands of people who want to feel safer.
Kickstarter allows us to take that step together with the people who want Heart2Heart to exist.
Your pledge helps us confirm our first production quantities and fund the production needed to bring Heart2Heart from beta to scale.
But backing Heart2Heart is also a way of showing that feeling unsafe in everyday life deserves more attention — and that we can rethink how we look out for each other when we feel unsafe.
## Rewards
Explore our exclusive Kickstarter rewards and find the perfect Heart2Heart for you!
During our campaign, you'll have the chance to pre-order Heart2Heart at special prices, with different rewards and bundles to choose from. You can choose your color after the campaign is over!
For the first 48 hours after launch, you can get Heart2Heart at 40% OFF with our exclusive Early Bird offer! Don't miss your chance to grab the best deal!
Shipping is not included in your reward and will be charged separately after the campaign. The prices below are our current shipping estimates and may change slightly.
## Where your support goes
Our Kickstarter goal is 50,000 DKK.

faq.a: Heart2Heart is a preventive safety keychain designed for the everyday moments when you feel unsafe. With a double press, you can share your location with the people you trust. They can follow your location and send heartbeat-like vibrations back to your Heart2Heart, letting you know they’re there with you — without you having to reach for your phone.

Heart2Heart connects to your phone via Bluetooth and works together with the Heart2Heart app.

When you activate Heart2Heart, your chosen trusted contacts receive a text message with a link to your location. From there, they can follow your location and send reassurance back to your Heart2Heart as heartbeat-like vibrations.

Heart2Heart is designed to help you reach out early — before an unsafe situation becomes an emergency.

faq.q: Is Heart2Heart an alarm or emergency button?
faq.a:
Heart2Heart isn’t a traditional personal alarm or emergency button. It’s designed for the moments when you feel unsafe or simply want someone you trust to know where you are — before a situation becomes an emergency.

Heart2Heart is designed to complement, not replace, emergency services.

faq.q: What do I need to use Heart2Heart?
faq.a:
All you need is your Heart2Heart keychain, a compatible smartphone (iOS 18.2+ or Android 13+), the Heart2Heart app and an active subscription.

Heart2Heart connects to your phone via Bluetooth and uses your phone's internet connection to keep you connected with your trusted contacts.

faq.q: Do my trusted contacts need Heart2Heart or the app?
faq.a:
No. Your trusted contacts don’t need their own Heart2Heart or the Heart2Heart app.

They simply need a phone that can receive text messages. When you activate Heart2Heart, they’ll receive a text message with a link that allows them to follow your location and send reassurance back to your Heart2Heart.

Only the trusted contacts you’ve selected in the Heart2Heart app receive access to your location when you activate Heart2Heart.

Heart2Heart does not continuously share your location with your contacts — you choose when to activate it.

faq.q: Do I need to have my phone with me?
faq.a:
Yes. Heart2Heart connects to your phone via Bluetooth and uses your phone’s GPS and internet connection to share your location with your trusted contacts.

The keychain means you can activate Heart2Heart without having to take out or interact with your phone.

Yes. An active subscription is required to use Heart2Heart’s connected features, including adding trusted contacts, sharing your live location, sending SMS alerts to your trusted contacts, and receiving reassuring vibrations from them.

Heart2Heart has a rechargeable battery and charges via USB-C.

You can check the battery level in the Heart2Heart app, so you know when it’s time to recharge.

faq.q: What if I activate Heart2Heart by mistake?
faq.a: Your Heart2Heart has a small sliding switch on the side, so you can choose when it’s turned on. If you accidentally trigger an alert, don’t worry! You can stop sharing your live location at any time through the Heart2Heart app or by turning off your keychain.

We're currently estimating that Kickstarter rewards will ship in March 2027!

We're working closely with our manufacturing partners to get Heart2Heart ready for production, and we'll keep you updated throughout the journey.

faq.q: Can I use Heart2Heart when travelling?
faq.a: Heart2Heart connects through your smartphone's Bluetooth and internet connection, making it possible to use its connected features wherever the required services are supported.

faq.q: How many SMS messages are included in my subscription, and what if I need more?
